# paperclip_user_company_access (Resource)

Manages the company access list for a specific user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_user_company_access" "operator_companies" {
  user_id     = data.paperclip_user.operator.id
  company_ids = [paperclip_company.acme.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_ids` (List of String) List of company IDs the user has access to.
- `user_id` (String) User identifier whose company access is managed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matches the user ID.
